# pangolin_redirect (Resource)

Manages a Pangolin redirect: requests matching a domain (or an HTTP resource) are answered with an HTTP redirect to another host. Exactly one of `resource_id` or `domain_id` must be set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pangolin_domains" "all" {}

# Domain-based redirect: everything under old.<domain>/docs is sent to the
# new documentation site with a permanent (308) redirect.
resource "pangolin_redirect" "old_docs" {
  name             = "old-docs"
  domain_id        = data.pangolin_domains.all.domains[0].domain_id
  subdomain        = "old"
  destination_host = "https://docs.example.com"

  path_match_type   = "prefix"
  match_path        = "/docs"
  rewrite_path_type = "stripPrefix"
  permanent         = true
}

# Redirect attached to an existing HTTP resource.
resource "pangolin_resource" "web" {
  name      = "my-app"
  subdomain = "app"
  domain_id = data.pangolin_domains.all.domains[0].domain_id
}

resource "pangolin_redirect" "legacy_path" {
  name             = "legacy-path"
  resource_id      = pangolin_resource.web.id
  destination_host = "https://example.com"

  path_match_type   = "exact"
  match_path        = "/legacy"
  rewrite_path_type = "exact"
  rewrite_path      = "/new"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination_host` (String) The redirect target as `scheme://host[:port]` (for example `https://example.com`), with no path, query or fragment. The request path (after any rewrite) is appended to it.
- `name` (String) The name of the redirect.

### Optional

- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain this redirect is attached to. Exactly one of `resource_id` or `domain_id` must be set.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the redirect is enabled. Defaults to `true`.
- `match_path` (String) The request path to match. When `path_match_type` is `regex` it must be a valid regular expression.
- `nice_id` (String) The human-readable ID. Generated by the server when unset; may be changed (letters, numbers and dashes only). A duplicate within the organization is rejected.
- `path_match_type` (String) How `match_path` is matched: `exact`, `prefix` or `regex`. Defaults to `regex`.
- `permanent` (Boolean) Whether the redirect is permanent: `true` answers with HTTP 308, `false` (the default) with HTTP 307.
- `priority` (Number) The match priority, from 1 to 1000. Defaults to 100.
- `resource_id` (Number) The ID of the HTTP resource this redirect is attached to. Exactly one of `resource_id` or `domain_id` must be set.
- `rewrite_path` (String) The replacement path appended to `destination_host`. Required when `rewrite_path_type` is set to anything other than `stripPrefix`.
- `rewrite_path_type` (String) How the path is rewritten: `exact`, `prefix`, `regex` or `stripPrefix`. `stripPrefix` removes the matched prefix and needs no `rewrite_path`.
- `ssl` (Boolean) Whether TLS is enabled for a domain-attached redirect. Defaults to `true`. Always `true` for a redirect attached to a resource (the server forces it), so `false` is rejected there.
- `subdomain` (String) The subdomain to redirect, combined with `domain_id`. May be multi-label or a wildcard (`*` or `*.apps`). Leave unset to use the base domain. Not allowed with `resource_id`: a resource-attached redirect uses the resource's domain.

### Read-Only

- `base_domain` (String) The base domain of the attached domain. Null when attached to a resource.
- `id` (String) The numeric ID of the redirect.
- `resource_full_domain` (String) The full domain of the attached resource. Null when attached to a domain.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Redirects import by numeric ID (the redirect ID shown in the Pangolin
# dashboard or returned by the API).
terraform import pangolin_redirect.example <redirect_id>
```
